SELECT substr(npdes_id, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What fixed rate did I bonds issued in November 2023 carry?
SELECT DISTINCT try_cast(fixed_rate AS double) AS fixed_rate FROM govblock_treasury.i_bonds_interest_rates WHERE issue_year_month = '2023-11'
Which court decisions have been cited most often?
SELECT case_name, try_cast(citation_count AS double) AS citations FROM govblock_courts.opinion_clusters ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many jobs were located in Manhattan in 2015?
SELECT sum(c000) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'ny' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2015 AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '36061'
Which departments listed the most rules in the fall 2024 regulatory agenda?

SELECT element_at(split(acronym, ' | '), 2) AS department, count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE cast(publication_id AS varchar) = '202410' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark applications were filed in each of the last ten years?
SELECT substr(cast(filing_dt AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE filing_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
At which companies did insiders give away the most shares as gifts in 2023?

SELECT s.issuername, sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double)) AS shares_gifted FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s ON s.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'G' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much revenue did the Oil Spill Liability Trust Fund receive in fiscal 2024?
Oil Spill Liability Trust Fund Results
SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS revenue FROM govblock_treasury.oil_spill_liability_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc = 'Revenue'
Which states lost the most pedestrians to traffic crashes in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS pedestrians_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '5' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds found in patents weigh more than 1,500 daltons?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_compounds WHERE mol_weight > 1500
Which states have the highest poverty rates?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_poverty FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b17001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many generators are planned to retire, by the operators' own reports?
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE trim(planned_retirement_year) <> ''
Which permit requirements are most often missed or met late?
SELECT schedule_event_desc, count(*) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_ps_violations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average age of people killed in traffic crashes in 2022?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(age AS integer)), 1) AS avg_age FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' AND try_cast(age AS integer) < 998
Which chemicals were discharged into water in the largest amounts in 2022?
SELECT _37_chemical AS chemical, round(sum(try_cast(_53_53_water AS double))) AS pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many active public water systems are owned by the federal government?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND owner_type_code = 'F'
At what hours of the day is New York's electricity demand highest on average?

SELECT hour_number, round(avg(try_cast(demand_mw AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did used car and truck prices climb from 2020 to 2022?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SETA02' AND period = 'M13' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2020', '2022') ORDER BY year
Which facilities injected the most toxic chemicals underground in 2022?

SELECT _4_facility_name AS facility, _8_st AS state, round(sum(try_cast(_54_54_underground AS double))) AS pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people riding bicycles died in traffic crashes in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS cyclists_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '6' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022'
Whose research is cited most, institution by institution?
SELECT display_name, country_code, try_cast(cited_by_count AS double) AS citations FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_institutions ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many brand names does ChEBI record?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_names WHERE type = 'BRAND NAME'
In which states are the companies that own the most U.S. patents based?

SELECT l.disambig_state AS state, count(DISTINCT a.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated a JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_location_disambiguated l ON l.location_id = a.location_id WHERE cast(a.assignee_type AS varchar) = '2' AND l.disambig_country = 'US' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospice cost reports were filed for fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_hospc14_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which industries win the most sub-contract dollars?

SELECT naics_description, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE subaward_type = 'sub-contract' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many jobs in accommodation and food service were located in Clark County, Nevada in 2019?
SELECT sum(try_cast(cns18 AS double)) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'nv' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '32003'
Which exclusion programs account for the most debarred entities?
SELECT exclusion_program, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_exclusions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many approved drugs in ChEMBL are natural products?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 4 AND natural_product = 1
Which companies filed the most 8-K current reports in 2024?

SELECT c.name, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings f JOIN govblock_sec.submissions_companies c ON c.cik = f.cik WHERE f.form = '8-K' AND substr(cast(f.filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the personal saving rate for 2020 as a whole?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS saving_rate FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadataa WHERE seriescode = 'A072RC' AND period = '2020'
Which manufacturers have issued the most recall campaigns?
SELECT mfgname, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many planned generators were cancelled before they were built?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS cancelled FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'CN'
Which plants have the most U.S. plant patents?
SELECT latin_name, count(*) AS plant_patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_botanic WHERE latin_name <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many veterans live in Ohio?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0400000US39' AND variable = 'B21001_E002'
Which arXiv subjects saw the most papers revised four or more times?
SELECT primary_category, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE try_cast(substr(latest_version, 2) AS integer) >= 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many candidates won their general election in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.candidate_summary WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2022' AND cast(gen_election AS varchar) = 'W'
Which cities in Texas have the most companies registered to do business with the federal government?
SELECT physical_address_city, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_province_or_state = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In how many hours of 2023 did the real-time price in western New York fall below zero?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE name = 'WEST' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' AND try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double) < 0
Which states deposited the most into the Unemployment Trust Fund in 2019?

SELECT acct_desc AS state, abs(sum(try_cast(shares_per_par AS double))) AS deposited FROM govblock_treasury.utf_account_statement WHERE report_type = 'State' AND trans_desc_cd LIKE '11-10%' AND substr(cast(eff_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2019' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average dipole moment of a QM9 molecule?
SELECT avg(mu) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_qm9
Which New York counties drew the most federal assistance in fiscal year 2023?

SELECT recipient_county_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal defect investigations have involved Tesla vehicles?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS investigations FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_investigations WHERE c2 = 'TESLA'
How has solar output on California's grid grown from year to year?

SELECT substr(data_date, 7, 4) AS year, round(sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double)))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'CISO' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in ChEMBL are in phase 3 clinical trials?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 3
